About the network

Connecting nature across North London.

We are a collaborative network of organisations and communities strengthening habitats, sharing knowledge and helping wildlife corridors grow out from Hampstead Heath.

Our purpose

Bigger, better and more connected.

Nature North London brings together community groups, conservation organisations, land managers and local partners. The network helps people see how individual projects connect to a larger living landscape.

Final About-page copy is expected from the organising team. This draft establishes the agreed structure and visual direction.
